paper_title: A Model-Independent Radio Telescope Dark Matter Search in the L and S Bands
suggested_experiment_name: GBT L/S band model-independent DM decay search
coupling_convention: decay rate lambda in s^-1 (as plotted on y-axis of Fig 9a)
notes: This is a model-independent radio telescope search for dark matter decay/annihilation to a radio line, using Breakthrough Listen GBT data over 1020-2700 MHz. The limits are reported on the decay constant lambda (s^-1) vs frequency (Fig. 8, 9a) and annihilation cross section <sigma v> (cm^3/s) vs frequency (Fig. 9b), NOT on a standard particle-physics coupling such as g_agamma, kinetic mixing, etc. The paper explicitly assumes two-photon final states for simplicity but frames results generically. Since the y-axis is a decay rate/cross section rather than any of the enumerated coupling types, no coupling_type applies and no data points in the required units can be extracted. Local density assumptions: rho_NFW(r_s)=0.471 GeV/cm^3, rho_Bur=0.487 GeV/cm^3.
